Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

How can I book an appointment?

Complete the form above, or call or WhatsApp the clinic directly using the displayed numbers.

How can I contact the clinic?

You can call 7000944387 or 7869869888. WhatsApp is available on 7000944387.

What is Panchkarma?

Panchkarma is a traditional Ayurvedic approach involving selected therapies planned after consultation.

What should I bring for my consultation?

Bring any relevant prescriptions, reports, and a list of current medicines if available.

Can I book a Panchkarma consultation online?

Yes. Select Panchkarma Consultation in the booking form and the clinic team can follow up.

Is Swarnaprashan consultation available?

Yes. Select Swarnaprashan in the service list to request a consultation.

Can I contact the clinic through WhatsApp?

Yes. Use the WhatsApp buttons on this page to contact the clinic.

How do I know which consultation is suitable?

Select Other or describe your concern in the form. The clinic team can guide you on the appropriate consultation.
